description: DemandRegio disaggregator is a Python toolkit for dividing aggregate final-energy demand by place and time. It handles electricity, heat and fuel demands for households, commerce and industry using database inputs and documented disaggregation functions. Inputs are regional or national demand totals, sector characteristics and time profiles; outputs are localised demand series and sector tables for modelling. Geographic coverage depends on the underlying DemandRegio database, with a German project focus, and time resolution follows the chosen functions. Source is free under GPL-3.0 and the repository provides installation instructions and four demonstration notebooks. A limitation is that disaggregated demand inherits uncertainty from allocation proxies and should not be treated as measured at every local site. Some database inputs are separate from the code. The tool can prepare loads for electricity and district-heating infrastructure simulations. It is related to PyPSA (model-pypsa) as a possible demand-input producer; no integration was tested.
name: DemandRegio energy-demand disaggregator
